result.summary: Found 3 issues: banner text is nearly invisible due to poor contrast, plus minor carousel truncation and bottom content clipping.

issues.description: Promotional banner '3 free deliveries for you' uses white text on a very light mint background, making the headline and subtext nearly unreadable / washed out.
issues.suggestion: Change banner text to a dark color with sufficient contrast or darken the background to meet WCAG contrast requirements

issues.description: Third card in 'Fastest near you' shows truncated restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off mid-word at the screen edge without ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add proper end padding to the horizontal carousel and truncate names with ellipsis instead of hard clipping

issues.description: Second card under 'Popular right now' (pizza image) is abruptly clipped by the bottom tab bar, hiding its name, rating and delivery info with no visible spacing.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding and safe-area inset so list items are not obscured behind the tab bar during scroll
